name: Lamborghini Urus (Widebody Kit)
blurb: The 2021 Lamborghini Urus with a striking widebody kit — white exterior, red cabin, flared arches, and Y-shaped LED glare. National Harbor’s showpiece SUV for weekends that need to be seen.
details: Archive product story: mesmerizing white exterior as a canvas for Lamborghini’s sculptural lines; widebody kit widens the stance with meticulously crafted flared wheel arches; red leather interior with carbon fiber and Alcantara accents.
yearNote: Product post describes a 2021 example (some list cards said 2023); confirm current chassis with concierge.

name: Rolls-Royce Ghost
blurb: 2023 Rolls-Royce Ghost in impeccable black — handcrafted V12 presence with optional chauffeur. Pantheon grille, Spirit of Ecstasy, and a starlight cabin for ceremonial evenings.
details: Archive product story: lustrous black exterior; hand-stitched black leather; starlight headliner; wood veneers and intuitive technology. Available across DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

name: Maserati Ghibli
blurb: Maserati Ghibli — Italian grand-tourer energy for city dinners and coastal drives without the ultra-SUV footprint.

name: Rolls-Royce Cullinan (Miami)
blurb: Cullinan tagged for the Miami chapter — South Beach through Brickell. Request transfer or local pickup with concierge.

name: Rolls-Royce Cullinan Black Badge
blurb: Black Badge Cullinan — darker, sharper presence for DMV arrivals that need absolute authority.

name: Aston Martin DB11
blurb: Aston Martin DB11 — grand-tourer lines for Annapolis evenings and open-road weekends. Elegance with a growl.

name: Rolls-Royce Wraith
blurb: Rolls-Royce Wraith — coupe drama under a starlight headliner for nights when the destination is the drive.

name: Bentley Bentayga
blurb: Bentley Bentayga — ultra-luxury SUV space for four with the finish of a private lounge.

name: Bentley Continental GT V8 S
blurb: Bentley Continental GT V8 S — grand touring posture for DC dinners and weekend coastal loops.

name: McLaren GT
blurb: McLaren GT from the National Harbor collection — dihedral drama and grand-tourer pace. Confirm availability with concierge before quoting.

name: Luxury Presidential Sprinter
blurb: Presidential Sprinter build with six captain’s chairs, ambient lighting, and room for the whole party — airport runs to weddings.

name: Ultimate Sprinter Van
blurb: 2021 Ultimate Mercedes-Benz Sprinter for events and family use — six plush captain’s chairs, entertainment, onboard restroom, refreshments, optional armed drivers, and guided DMV tours.
details: Archive product story: bar removed for more seating; private bathroom with elbow room; stocked beverage service; common uses include airport, corporate, wedding, prom, and funeral transport.

name: Executive AC Sprinter
blurb: Executive climate-controlled Sprinter for corporate shuttles and multi-stop days across the DMV.
